title: http.registry.contract.submit.v1.request
description: Submit a runtime contract registration. The submitter identity is taken from the authenticated principal, not the body. Fields mirror the kernel registry SubmitInput (#2233); the (kind,domain,version,owner) uniqueness quadruple is owned by US15/FR-009 and not modeled here.

id.description: Registration identifier (the contract id, e.g. http.example.foo.v1); dedup key. A duplicate id yields 409.

payloadSchema.description: Opaque payload-schema reference/hash recorded at submit; uninterpreted by the kernel state machine (US5 persists it).
